_comment: Hand-confirmed evidence tiers for notes where tools/notes_audit.py could not derive
the measurement host from the note text alone.  'tier' uses the vocabulary of
tools/notes_audit.py (EVIDENCE_TIERS); 'note' records WHY, so a later reader can
re-check the judgement instead of trusting it.
'confidence: high' means the host is pinned by the note itself (usually by an
explicit Silicon:/Status: line).  'medium' means a strong but indirect marker.
Generated and applied by: python3 tools/notes_migrate.py --status --apply

ARCH_DIFF.md.note: opcode-space diff of the ISA dumps; no hardware measurement.

CUBIN_STRUCTURE.md.note: states cuModuleLoadData execution on both sm_120 (RTX 5090) and sm_90 (H20).

DEVICE_PRINT.md.note: printf buffer format documented from device runs; host unnamed -> default site.

sm100/OVERVIEW.md.note: diff of sm100_instructions.txt vs the Hopper dumps; parser validation only.

sm100/arch/control_codes.md.note: field-position delta between the two spec dumps, not a hardware probe.

sm100/arch/mercury_capmerc.md.note: B200 firmware/driver packet analysis; no host named -> notes/sm100 default.

sm100/arch/tcgen05_descriptors.md.note: descriptor bit fields corroborated on B200 runs described in utchmma.md.

sm100/arch/tcgen05_microarch_speculation.note: speculation model fitted to B200 measurements.

sm100/arch/tcgen05_multiwarp_allocator_v.note: **v1 is historical**: superseded by v2; kept for the allocator bring-up record.
states B200 local dump plus repeated B200+B300 lifecycle runs.

sm100/arch/tcgen05_tooling_checkpoint.md.note: explicitly a 'checkpoint of the state when hardware probing paused' -> Status: historical.

sm100/arch/tmem_atexit_handler.md.note: TMEM atexit behaviour measured on B200 in the tcgen05 sessions.

sm100/arch/tmem_entry_fragment.md.note: entry-fragment layout measured on B200 (Modal probe tools/modal_sm100_entry_fragment.py).

sm103/b300_mufu_ex2_throughput.md.note: explicit Silicon: line; B300 measured vs B200/H100/GB202 as references.

sm103/rf_bank_probe.md.note: explicit Chinese status line: Modal B300 measurement compared with the B200 result.

sm120/index.md.note: directory index listing both sm_100 and sm_120 subjects; not itself a measurement.

sm120/l2_slice_probe.md.note: GB202/RTX 5090 probe; sm90 appears only as a cross-reference.

sm89/scalar_math_pipelines.md.note: states Probed on RTX 4090 (AD102) with CS2R timing.

sm90/arch/l2_numa_h800.md.note: probed on a remote H800 PCIe; the RTX 5090 mention is a contrast, not the site.

sm90/arch/pipe_forward_survey.md.note: title states the survey is on SM120 (RTX 5090 / GB202); sm_90 only in refs.

sm90/arch/ptx_memory_model_to_sass.md.note: explicit: SASS verified on sm_90/sm_90a, hardware behaviour on RTX 5090.

sm90/arch/register_bandwidth.md.note: H800 (full GH100, sm_90) measurement; sm70/sm80/sm120 appear as comparisons.

sm90/arch/sm90_resilver_audit.md.note: run-matrix ledger; its generated block is the live view (phase 3).

sm120/silver-status.md.note: regression ledger; the b14 progress log is history, the generated block is live.

sm90/instr/bra.md.note: sassdbg/probe_jmp_modifiers.py ran on H20 SM90 and RTX 5090 SM120.

sm90/instr/call.md.note: CALL/RET matrix probe (probe3) on both H20 and RTX 5090.

sm90/instr/jmp.md.note: JMP immediate probe run on H20 SM90 and RTX 5090 SM120.

sm90/instr/up2ur.md.note: banner: byte-exact vectors from sm_120, semantics halves passed on H20.

sm90/instr/f2f.md.note: Resolved: silicon-verified (SM120) heading; no H20 attestation.

sm90/instr/bmsk.md.note: Silicon-verified 14-case battery + RUR on the local Blackwell part.

sm90/instr/hmnmx2.md.note: Resolved: semantics verified (SM120, clean hand-built ELF).
